All doors assumed 0-2.1 m; all windows assumed sill 0.9 m / head 2.4 m, including the long 4800/4880 glazing bands.
Door leaf swing directions read from cyan arcs; states unknown.
Interior partitions modeled on drawn line-pair midplanes (240 mm).
Corridor and east lobby are one continuous space (no wall drawn between wall-cor-r-n and wall-cor-r-s); single seed s-cor covers it.
